notes.content:
Embark on a brutal re-imagining of the King Arthur mythos as Uther, a vengeful knight aided by Merlin, an eldritch sorcerer, in search of the long-lost Excalibur. Survive intense turn-based combat in this tactical RPG as you travel Broken Britannia, a land devastated by intrigue and deceit.

notes.title: One year of Sword Legacy: Omen!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

This week marked the one year anniversary of Sword Legacy: Omen!

Over the past year the game has been nominated for some amazing awards and we really hope you enjoyed venturing across our arthurian world, these awards include: 

 Best Game - IndieX 2018 / Lisboa Games Week
 Best Storytelling - SB Games Festival
 Best Brazillian PC Game - International Comics Week / UFRJ


 Best Brazillian Game - BIG Festival (nominee)
 Gamers Voice: Video game award 2019 - SXSW (nominee)
 Indie Prize USA 2019 (nominee) 
 Indie Prize Europe 2018 (nominee)
 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/310de84731b73aca69d4aa497b8202d317e13707.png

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you all for your continued support and to give something back to you. 

To start, here is a previously unreleased animation that was initially included in the Deluxe edition of the game!

https://youtu.be/0XancQid1lc

Competition time!

As part of the celebrations, we’re also giving away 3 copies of the Sword Legacy: Omen Deluxe edition!

To enter, make sure to keep an eye out on our social media channels for when it goes live in the near future.

If you’re not following us already, you can do so using the links below:

Twitter
Facebook

notes.title: Learn more about Sword Legacy + another award nomination!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/578d5c84c00e7ff40dbe0ab6b9a2f9b74519b2c2.png
Hi everyone

Sword Legacy on the weR1 youR2 podcast
If you'd like to learn more about the origins and development of Sword Legacy: Omen, tune in to the weR1 youR2 podcast where Arthur Protasio, Creative Director at Fableware Narrative Design, joined to discuss indie development, narrative and all things Sword Legacy. There's so much information crammed in, they had to split it into two episodes!

Listen to episode 1
Listen to episode 2

Sword Legacy: Omen nominated at SXSW
We're incredibly honoured that Sword Legacy: Omen has been nominated for the Gamer's Voice: Video Game award at SXSW Gaming 2019. The game is nominated alongside some amazing video games, so even the nomination is phenomenal. You can read about the nomination here.

Should you find yourself at SXSW in March, come meet the developers at the Sword Legacy booth in the Indie Corner and vote for us!

That's all for now. We hope you're all having a great time in Britannia and wish you good fortunes on the battlefield. Long live the legacy!

notes.title: Tactical Tips and Class Builds
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/0415bd6bdada76c3028afb2ae2e4001646d7966c.png
Greetings, tacticians!

Since the release of Sword Legacy we’ve seen the community discussing different strategies and party configurations used in the game. It's amazing to see how each player takes on a different approach and we’re thankful for your participation. Regardless if you’re a newcomer or an experienced TBS veteran, we’ve put together a quick guide to aid you in your adventures throughout Broken Britannia!

Ready? Let’s dive in!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/4e551c507ef7dae6d8f84c2b2b25fbea1c3bda0d.jpg
Please note that the below contains minor gameplay and story spoilers.

The basics
The basics of combat rely on much more than just mindlessly unleashing frontal attacks. Carefully assessing the battlefield and your resources is always highly recommended:
- Always check your AP! Use it to activate Willpower, Potions, Items and Overwatch;
- Never skip a visit to the blacksmith. Buying better weapons grants extra damage, fancy effects and raises your chance of hitting the enemies;
- Pay attention to where your heroes are facing and avoid back-attacks! You can have a party member face somewhere else at no AP cost by clicking RMB on the board in the desired direction;
- Your enemies have stats, skills and maybe even Special Talents. Inspect them at any moment by pressing Shift+LMB over them.

Each hero is unique
The real power in combat comes from the ones that achieve victory through the clever use of positioning, swift speed and physical might. Each hero offers different possibilities, aiming for different effects. Here are a few examples:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/1efb8f99ed7270ddcda59452ffcb1985b4f929f6.jpg

UTHER, CROWD CONTROLLER
Uther already boasts great defense, but his armor normally limits his AP more than other heroes. So, instead of walking towards combat, bring it upon yourself! Combine Taunt with Ultimate Defense to attract as many enemies as possible and make them waste their attacks. On the next turn, use Arc Slash against every enemy around you at once. Counterattack is a nice addition since it can deal extra damage if someone lands an attack.

MERLIN, CROWD DESTROYER
Merlin is a formidable hero, but not the sturdiest. To maximize his longevity, make the best use of Soul Eater, granting free healing with each kill. Concentrate Fireball or Chain Lightning on enemy groups to deal high damage to various foes at once. Play it safe and always keep the Teleport skill handy if you need to escape approaching enemies.

DUANNE, FORMATION BREAKER
Duanne is a melee warrior with some interesting perks. If you opt to use him as a damage dealer, his Charge skill is indispensable, as he’ll move and deal damage to targets in line. Combine this with a Half Moon attack to strike as many foes as possible. Also, the boost provided by Desperate Measures is a good call.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/7a34c7ba8ee529e07b39b98c91ec2998abd831fa.jpg

GWEN, INVISIBLE ASSASSIN
You can’t go wrong with the Stealth and Dash combination. The former boosts Gwen’s next attack and protects her from enemy detection while the latter has her move the farthest spending only two AP. On your next turn, unleash Dust before attacking or go all-in with a Flurry attack. Just remember to equip your Savoir-faire for that extra Critical-Chance.

FELIX, HOLY SUPPORT
Felix possesses a great variety of skills to better prepare your party for battle. Bless Weapon works nicely with every attacking hero while Bless Armor increases the defense of any ally who might be facing several enemies. Sacred Ground grants an area heal and you can equip either Heal just to be safe or Aura for an extra buff.

FERGHUS, UNSTOPPABLE BEAST
The Barbarian holds no secrets. Unleash your Rage of the Ancients to gain that nice Attack +1. Then, use Spree thanks to its awesome AP economy: if you manage to guarantee one kill at the beginning of the turn. Frenzied Beast may save 2 more extra AP while disrupting enemy positions, and Bloodlust will make the damage last even further.

FLINT, SNIPER SUMMONER
The ability to attack at a farther range makes Flint unmatched. Marksfayeship and Flèche Fatale combine nicely, while Raven/Wolf Call summons Skull or Cyrus to protect them from afar. Quick Draw sacrifices your Attack bonus but decreases skill cooldowns.

GORR, BARRICADE GRENADIER
With a smart use of Stone Wall, Gorr can set a barrier between himself and the enemy or lure them into a vulnerable spot. That’s when you fire your ranged attacks: be it Liquor Bomb for the extra burning damage or Build Automaton for the fireworks - Gorr always leaves an exploding impression. You can also equip one of his passive skills for extra protection.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/802f77075237aab2f76093e61eb400ee478ac82b.png

All of these builds offer powerful synergies. Felix’s support goes along with everything, but teleporting Merlin close to him is always very useful. Ferghus, Duanne and Flint’s summon are effective if you decide to opt for close-quarters combat, while Flint and Merlin can attack from afar. Gwen, due to her high maneuverability and Stealth skill, can advance with ease and retreat for healing/protection, while Uther and Gorr protect the party - acting as shields or distracting enemies.

These are just a few of the possible strategies! Which ones do you use? Let us know in the comments below or over on the forums! We're eager to hear your impressions and suggestions!

Long live the legacy!

notes.title: COMPETITION: Name an allied creature in Sword Legacy: Omen!
notes.content:
Greetings and salutations, strategy fans! If you’re here on this page then it’s because you’re interested in Sword Legacy: Omen, and we want to reward you with a unique chance to participate in the creation of the game!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/05b9042f59d6a63eb54af89d82a9ced46c2e5605.jpg

We are looking for two imaginative gamers who will come up with names for the raven and wolf. These are creatures summoned into battle by Flint, Sword Legacy: Omen’s archer and “Wild Keeper”. Impress us with a suitable name and your suggestion may well find its way into the final game!

THE RULES
So what do you need to do to enter?
Simple: Just comment in the contest forum thread with your name suggestions for either the raven or the wolf (or both!) and we’ll pick two winners on the 30th of November.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30961408/de41f489609199cfe031b6211d4feb3e3ffa2859.jpg

To help you along, here’s some advice

• Get to know Sword Legacy: Omen and the world of Broken Britannia. Watch the trailers and try to think of names that would fit alongside characters like Uther, Gwen and Duanne. Don't be afraid to research some Old English and Gaelic names.

• Keep it short and sweet. As much as we might enjoy suggestions like Lord Wolfy “Paws” Wolfington III, it’s unlikely that we’ll pick such a lengthy name.

• Think about the characteristics of the creatures. Each is extremely valuable in combat, both in an offensive capacity and as a way to defend our heroes.

•  Take a look at their visual designs on this page to get those creative juices flowing.

Enter here!

https://media.giphy.com/media/l2QDYrJHo31WZdC6c/giphy.gif


https://media.giphy.com/media/xT0xePiOftwOiAd5II/giphy.gif
